catalog_name: Python Eye IDE – Verified Tool Catalog
notes: Nine unique Sync tools: original eight unchanged in id/version/install fields, plus official Maven R8 8.11.18 with real Android-side dual D8/R8 test. Installed/working only after phone checks.

tools.name: OpenJDK 17
tools.description: Java runtime/compiler for Gradle, D8, apksigner and Kotlin
tools.note: Termux Bionic OpenJDK 17.0.21 WITH libawt/libawt_headless + NEEDED libs bundled in jdk/lib (fixes Lint 'no awt in system library path'); cacerts de-absolutized for the on-device extractor. The Android heap pointer-tag abort (exit 134, Gradle/Kotlin) is handled by the IDE preloading its heap-tag-compat shim (mallopt heap-tagging NONE) into every JDK build subprocess — the app manifest flag cannot reach exec'd children because the tagged-address ABI is reset on execve(). CI termux-docker verify: Swing EDT (HeadlessToolkit), PNG/JPEG ImageIO, LCMS, javac, keytool, jarsigner PASS. On-device end-to-end build verification pending. Previous toolchain-v1 JDK asset kept for rollback.

tools.name: Gradle
tools.description: Gradle distribution; pin final version after AGP and Chaquopy compatibility testing
tools.note: Pure Java Gradle launcher still requires Android-compatible Java and launch integration. Android runs JVM CLI directly to avoid missing Unix/bash launchers; tested compile-side, device verification pending.

tools.name: Android SDK Platform 36
tools.description: Android platform APIs including android.jar; not the full Android SDK

install.preflight: Check JDK 17, sdkmanager, platform SDK license; install platforms;android-36 and build-tools;35.0.0

tools.note: Google SDK license acceptance required. Install from sdkmanager, not a mirrored Release archive. Runnable managed installer script is now included in repo, but Kotlin IDE UI is not wired to invoke it; status remains not_published until on-device verified.

tools.name: AAPT2 + Zipalign
tools.description: Must use tested Android ARM64 executables, not Linux x86_64 builds
tools.warning: This 35.0.2 archive has AAPT2 + Zipalign but no D8, apksigner, jars or source.properties. It is not a full SDK Build Tools installation.
tools.note: Verified archive contains AArch64 ELF binaries (AAPT2 and Zipalign 35.0.2). Android Bionic/runtime execution not yet proven. Installer strips build-tools/ from the ZIP; test uses ./aapt2, not ./build-tools/aapt2.

tools.name: D8 + R8 + APK Signer
tools.description: Android bytecode tools: D8 dexer, R8 shrinker/obfuscator through AGP Release minifyEnabled, and APK signing. R8 is included in AGP, no separate Android executable is required.
tools.warning: Older 34.0.4 archive contains both Java launch scripts and jar files; mixing with SDK Build Tools 35.0.0 requires an app-level installer plan.
tools.note: Legacy 34.0.4 D8/APKSigner Java JARs, not a replacement for AGP 8.11's mandatory Android SDK Build Tools >= 35. Android runs JVM CLI directly to avoid missing Unix/bash launchers; tested compile-side, device verification pending. R8 Release Checker is now exposed in this existing catalog tool record. A Sync only refreshes fields the installed Python Eye IDE parser actually supports.

r8.note: Checker inspects configuration only; release APK must be built and independently signed with a private keystore.

tools.name: Kotlin Compiler
tools.description: Kotlin compilation; final version to match the tested Android Gradle Plugin
tools.warning: Version 2.1.20 is the published tool; remove any duplicate built-in Kotlin 2.3.21 entry on the Android app side.
tools.note: Kotlin JVM compiler archive; Gradle plugin must still resolve correctly for Android builds. Android runs JVM CLI directly to avoid missing Unix/bash launchers; tested compile-side, device verification pending.

tools.name: Android Gradle Plugin
tools.description: Android app build plugin, sourced through Maven dependency resolution · Maven plugin resolution needs JDK and Gradle; standalone D8 is for separate CLI tasks, not a plugin prerequisite.
tools.note: Plugin and transitives must resolve through Gradle. Requires Gradle >=8.13, JDK17 and SDK Build Tools 35.0.0. Runnable managed installer script is now included in repo, but Kotlin IDE UI is not wired to invoke it; status remains not_published until on-device verified.

tools.name: Chaquopy Build Plugin
tools.description: Packages Python into Android APK; requires compatible AGP and Python version
tools.note: Gradle plugin via Maven Central for Python 3.10+, AGP 7.3-9.5, Android API >=24. Runnable managed installer script is now included in repo, but Kotlin IDE UI is not wired to invoke it; status remains not_published until on-device verified.

tools.name: R8 Optimizer + D8 (Official Maven)
tools.description: Independent R8/D8 Java shrinker, obfuscator and dexer resolved from Google's Maven repository. Load downloads official R8 jar, Test runs both D8 and R8 --version on phone. APK release signing remains separate.
tools.note: Python Eye v1.6.7 Kotlin ManagedToolResolver provides this Maven Load and dual-class Test route. Successful CLI Test does not sign or obfuscate ARINA; AGP release minification must run during assembleRelease. No fake download URL.

reported_android_ui_issue: Built-in unpublished entries and downloaded catalog entries are displayed together, producing duplicate AAPT2 and Kotlin cards. Requires fixing Kotlin catalog loader; remote JSON cannot remove bundled entries.
